training_rule: For every scored decision date, train only on rows whose 12-month endpoint is strictly earlier than the decision date.
selection_rule: Architecture, feature recipe, label objective, hyperparameters, score blend and penalties are selected only on 2020-2023 development_selection_dates. All 2024 and 2025 labels remain sealed until a locked selection exists. Untouched final dates are evaluated once and cannot influence selection.
final_integrity_rule: The final 2025-01-31 and 2025-08-31 outcomes must not be read, summarized, or used in any search before locked_selection.json is written. They are new to prior championship research.
current_facts_policy: Current company facts may map ISIN to a price-history file only; no present-day sector or fundamental value may be a historical model feature.
promotion_rule: A replacement requires broad improvement across robust aggregate metrics without material profile/date regressions; extreme mean XIRR has zero selection weight.
